Partner One Capital / NetWitness - Presales Engineer: live Euremot listing, but requires Dutch and English fluency.
Welo Data - Project Lion Senior Prompt Engineer: live Lever listing, but requires native Italian, 4+ years prompt engineering, and a technical/analytical degree.
Redcare Pharmacy - AI Solutions Engineer / AI Enablement Engineer: SmartRecruiters listing requires a CS/AI/data engineering technical degree and strong Python/Azure Databricks.
360Learning - Solutions Engineer DACH: live Lever posting, but requires fluent German and restricts hiring to Germany, France, UK or Spain.
Talent Factor Ltd - AI Solutions Engineer: SmartRecruiters posting is an agency listing and requires native/near-native German or Spanish/Italian; no named end client.
Jobgether Lever listings: aggregator/repost with no named end client; excluded under the staffing/aggregator gate.
ThriveCart - Quality Assurance Engineer: Euremot page loaded but was posted 6 months ago, outside freshness window.

Lemon.io Senior AI Engineer and Senior .NET Full-stack Developer: Euremot pages are marketplace placements and require 3-5+ years plus Python/.NET stacks; excluded for aggregator/seniority/stack mismatch.
aijobs.net: current URL redirects to Foorilla hiring shell rather than a verifiable individual posting; channel is a dead end for this sweep.
channel_notes: Himalayas API search URLs were inaccessible through the permitted WebFetch tool; board HTML results were stale/non-chronological and did not yield a verifiable Italy-eligible survivor.
aijobs.net no longer exposes its prior job board at the checked URL; it redirects to Foorilla and should not be swept again unless a new direct listing route is found.
